title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass European Style For Bathroom | Pink | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom with a freestanding toilet tissue stand that needs no wall mounting and keeps a spare roll within easy reach in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base to help prevent tipping, this stand is a practical solution when wall space is limited. The European style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Heavy base helps reduce tipping
- Solid brass construction
- Offered in a wide variety of designer finish options

Specs:
- Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 26-Inch H x 6.75-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembled in the USA

Works well with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
